ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me use, understand concepts, give examples, and debug based on it.

dropdown-menu.basic-note: Click the button to open the dropdown menu with simple actions.
dropdown-menu.description: Displays a list of actions or commands in an overlay triggered by a button or other interactive element.
dropdown-menu.disabled-items-note: Disabled items are skipped during keyboard navigation.

examples.note: Start with the basic menu, then explore content, groups, and submenus below.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package and import the components.

dropdown-menu.keyboard-item-2: Home / End: Jump to first/last item
dropdown-menu.keyboard-item-4: Escape: Close menu and return focus
dropdown-menu.keyboard-item-6: ArrowRight: Open submenu on focused submenu trigger
dropdown-menu.keyboard-item-7: ArrowLeft: Close submenu and return focus to parent trigger
dropdown-menu.keyboard-note: Dropdown Menu supports full keyboard navigation: Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape, and typeahead.
dropdown-menu.placements-note: Menu can appear on different sides of the trigger.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

dropdown-menu.radio-items-note: Use type="radio" for mutually exclusive options.
dropdown-menu.size-density-note: Control menu dimensions with size and density.
dropdown-menu.submenu-basic-note: Items with a trailing chevron open a nested submenu beside the trigger.
dropdown-menu.submenu-disabled-note: Disabled submenu triggers are skipped during keyboard navigation and do not open.
dropdown-menu.submenu-icons-note: Submenus support icons, dividers, and keyboard navigation.
dropdown-menu.submenu-nested-note: Submenus can be nested. Recommended maximum: 2 levels.
dropdown-menu.title: Dropdown menu
dropdown-menu.with-divider-note: Use Solaris Divider between groups of actions.
dropdown-menu.with-groups-note: Organize items using labels and groups.
dropdown-menu.with-icons-note: Menu items can display leading icons.
dropdown-menu.with-shortcuts-note: Display keyboard shortcut hints next to menu items.
